name: rcore_app
description: Hub-only Frappe compose template: rokctapp.json's module set with the subscriptions and wallet modules composing both their tenant and control personas, so the control-persona code lives only in the hub and never in the tenant rokctapp docker.
_comment: Cloned from rokctapp.json. subscriptions and wallet carry a per-module "personas": ["tenant","control"] override, so their src/tenant/ and src/control/ trees compose regardless of the shell's app_type marker. Enabled after control#179 dropped control's seven duplicate doctype JSONs (Company Subscription, Subscription Settings, Subscription Plan Module, Subscription Voucher, Customer Wallet, Wallet Ledger, Tenant Payout Request) and re-exported them from the subscriptions and wallet SDKs (control/control/sdk_reexport.py), so the cohosted_apps duplicate-doctype check no longer collides. The subscriptions and pay pins match control.json, because the composer clones one ref per repo.

modules.name: gateways
modules._comment: Same pay pin as erp/hrms/wallet below: the composer clones one ref per repo, so every pay module entry must share it. Replaces the retired 'pay' entry (../pay/payments/frappe no longer carries a frappe module or manifest.json): pay's payments/frappe content moved into the gateways and wallet modules, so this template mirrors rcore.json's wallet+gateways pair.

modules.name: telemetry
modules._comment: Composes every persona (no override): since core#346 telemetry's src/control/ tree no longer defines Tenant Error Log or Tenant Visitor Log (the fleet module owns them), so it no longer collides with fleet or the cohosted control app. Pinned to the same core ref as base and comms, because the composer clones one ref per repo.

modules.name: erp
modules._comment: ERPNext v16 fork flattened into one composed module (fork of frappe/erpnext via Frappenize/erpnext@rokct-hotfix). Upstream crm/projects/support modules are excluded and resolve to the productivity repo's SDK modules; the five fleet-colliding doctypes (Branch, Brand, Delivery Settings, Subscription, Subscription Settings + dependents) are excluded per pay#35's collision review, so erp composes beside base/subscriptions/products/delivery. A site composed with this module must NOT also have upstream erpnext installed. Pinned at the pay head carrying the fleet-collision exclusion; strict-compose verified at this SHA.

modules.name: hrms
modules._comment: Frappe HR fork (via Frappenize/hrms@rokct-hotfix). Composes ONLY alongside the erp module above — the Employee master and accounting doctypes live in erp, and every upstream erpnext reference resolves to {app_name}.erp. Never add hrms to a template without erp. Same pay pin as erp.

modules.name: crm
modules._comment: Core CRM slice (leads, deals, contacts, organizations, notes, tasks, call logs, statuses) ported from Frappenize/crm (frappe/crm fork) into the productivity SDK. Composing this module replaces installing the standalone frappe/crm app — a site must NOT have frappe/crm installed alongside rcore, since the doctype names (CRM Lead, CRM Deal, ...) are intentionally identical and would double-define. Existing sites need one 'bench execute rcore.patches.crm_seed_defaults.execute' to seed default statuses.

modules.name: studio
modules._comment: Studio operations layer from the designer repo (design systems, requests, approvals and proofs, print jobs, prepress, hot folder) — the backend of studio_sdk in the rokctapp Next.js template. Same module startupos.json composes.

modules.name: fleet
modules._comment: Fleet SDK module (control-split step 4, control#181): hub registry and channel, server agent, lifecycle, moves, rings and the fleet board, composed to {app}.fleet.control.* with doctypes under {app}/fleet/doctype/ (Frappe module fleet). Its manifest is the single source of the fleet scheduler jobs, doc_events, control: cmds and control_upgrade_result; control 1.7.1 registers its shim-path copies only when fleet is not composed. The cohosted duplicate-doctype scan skips SDK module dirs (any subdir with a manifest.json) inside a cohosted app checkout, so control/fleet/frappe does not count as control's own doctypes. Pinned to the control#181 merge SHA.

cohosted_apps.name: control
cohosted_apps._comment: The live control app installed on the same hub site; the composer fails if this composed app would define any DocType it also defines.
